name: data_get_pine_labels
description: Read text labels drawn by Pine Script indicators (label.new). Returns text and price pairs. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.

study_filter.description: Substring to match study name. Omit for all.

max_labels.description: Max labels per study (default 50). Set higher if you need all.

verbose.description: Return raw label data with IDs, colors, positions (default false — returns only text + price)
